evals.prompt: make me a dashboard of this
evals.expected_output: Almost nothing is inferable, so the 'Dashboard details' form appears with goal, cadence, request, success criteria, audience and review depth (no data question, since the file is attached). Nothing preselected; no persona names.
expectations: An intake form (or the structured-question fallback) was shown before any profiling or plan
The form did not ask where the data is, because a file was attached
No option was preselected and no persona names (Executive, Analyst, etc.) appear
Every prompt is phrased as a question

evals.prompt: every morning I want to check whether any support team is falling behind on resolution time, just for me, just build it
evals.expected_output: Goal monitor, cadence daily, audience me, review depth quick are all inferred, so no form. Plan has KPI targets, an exceptions line, Last updated, at most 4 charts; the 'here's what I assumed' card comes after building.
expectations: No intake form was shown (everything was inferable)
plan.md has goals including monitor, cadence: daily, audience: me, review_depth: quick
plan.md has a KPI target and an exceptions line
The assumptions card or list was shown after building, not before

evals.prompt: my VP forwarded this: 'Why did returns go up last quarter? I need something for the monthly leadership review, and the numbers have to match the finance report.' Data attached.
evals.expected_output: From the forwarded request: goal answer (+ present), cadence monthly, audience leadership, reconcile on, so review depth deep. A short form asks only for what's missing (e.g. success criteria). A confirmation card is shown before the plan is written; the plan has reconcile: true and a 'Reconcile with' line.
expectations: Goal, audience and cadence were taken from the forwarded request, not asked
Review depth is deep because reconciliation was requested
A confirmation card with 'My read', assumptions with Change buttons, and 'Looks right, build it' was shown before the plan was written
plan.md has reconcile: true and a 'Reconcile with:' line, and no SQL on page

evals.prompt: build a bar chart of satisfaction by department and a histogram of satisfaction, with a department filter. nothing else.
evals.expected_output: Goal spec: no form, no story, exactly the two charts and the menu; assumptions listed after building.
expectations: No intake form and no confirmation card before building
plan.md has goals: spec and exactly two charts (one bar by department, one histogram of satisfaction) and Menus: department
satisfaction is averaged in the bar chart, not summed

evals.expected_output: Asked as a follow-up after a confirmation card: one focused question about the comparison period only (3–5 options plus the current value); nothing else re-asked; the card is shown again with the change marked.
expectations: Exactly one question was asked, about the comparison period only
The intake form was not shown again
The updated card marks what changed
